name: hud
description: Hud Runtime Code Sensor: function-level production context (errors, latency, deployments, forensics) for your coding agent.

interface.longDescription:
Hud gives your coding agent read-only access to how your code behaves in production, recorded by Hud's Runtime Code Sensor at the function level: invocations, latency percentiles, error rates, exceptions, the endpoints and queues each function serves, deployments, and sampled forensic traces of failing requests.

Use it to debug production errors and slow endpoints, check whether a deployment caused a regression, find which endpoints call a function before you change it, or confirm whether code is used at all.

Intended for engineering teams whose services run the Hud SDK (Node.js, Python, Java, Kotlin). You sign in with your Hud account and only see data from services in that account.

Limitations: Hud is read-only and cannot change code, data or deployments. Services without the Hud SDK return no data. Forensic traces are sampled, so not every request is available.
defaultPrompt: Why is this endpoint failing in production?
Which endpoints call the function I am about to change?
Did the last deployment cause a regression?

positive.prompt: Which endpoints in magician-props-api had the most 500 errors in production in the last 24 hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of endpoints with invocation counts, 500 counts and error rates for the last 24 hours, labeled with service and environment.

positive.description: Investigate the root cause of an endpoint error
positive.prompt: Why is POST /orders in magician-props-api failing in production?
positive.expected_behavior: Follows Hud's endpoint-error playbook, reports the error rate and the exception behind the failures (type, message, throwing function), and separates what Hud shows from inference.

positive.prompt: Which endpoints in magician-props-api are slowest in production right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists endpoints ordered by p95 or p99 latency with invocation counts and the time window used.

positive.prompt: Did the most recent deployment of magician-props-api change error rates or latency?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the latest deployment and compares error rates and latency before and after it, or says no deployment was found in the window.

positive.description: Search failure traces for a pattern
positive.prompt: Find failing requests in magician-props-api from the last week that mention total_amount and group them by cause.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches sampled forensic traces, groups matching failures by cause and reports counts, or states that no matching traces were sampled.

negative.description: Write actions are out of scope: Hud is read-only
negative.prompt: Delete the failed orders from the magician-props-api production database.

negative.description: Operational actions are out of scope: Hud cannot change deployments
negative.prompt: Roll back the last deployment of magician-props-api.

negative.description: Access is limited to the connected Hud account
negative.prompt: Show me production errors for another company's services in Hud.

review.commerce_description: Hud does not sell products or process payments in this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connects Codex and ChatGPT to the Hud MCP server (OAuth sign-in) with a skill that guides production investigations: errors, latency, deployment impact and forensic traces.
